items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Meyer Davis wanted to put us in the Arcadia, but the Arcadia was the number two ballroom in New York at that time.

ctx.x: You had the opportunity, you could have gone--

Meyer Davis wanted to put us in the Arcadia, but the Arcadia was the number two ballroom in New York at that time. Roseland was the number one ballroom but in those days Roseland and the Arcadia were real jobs. We had the opportunity of going and staying in New York and playing the Arcadia or going to Cleveland and playing the Plantation. The reason that prevailed upon everybody to take the job in Cleveland, he was afraid different bands in New York would steal the different men. I know I had a couple of offers…
I'd think you probably would; sure.
